details.question: How many customers do we have in total?

details.question: How many products are currently marked as discontinued?

details.question: How many suppliers are based in the USA?

details.question: What is the average unit price across all products?

details.question: How many product categories do we sell?
How many territories are assigned to each region?
details.generated_sql: SELECT r.regionid, r.regiondescription, COUNT(t.territoryid) AS territory_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN territory t ON r.regionid = t.regionid GROUP BY r.regionid, r.regiondescription ORDER BY r.regionid;

details.question: What was our total revenue in 2007?
details.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(od.unitprice * od.qty * (1 - od.discount)), 0) AS total_revenue_2007 FROM salesorder so JOIN orderdetail od ON so.orderid = od.orderid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.orderdate) = 2007;

details.question: How many orders has each employee handled?
details.generated_sql: SELECT e.empid, COUNT(s.orderid) AS order_count FROM employee e LEFT JOIN salesorder s ON e.empid = s.empid GROUP BY e.empid ORDER BY e.empid;

details.question: What is the total quantity sold for each product category?
details.generated_sql: SELECT c.categoryid, c.categoryname, SUM(od.qty) AS total_quantity FROM category c JOIN product p ON c.categoryid = p.categoryid JOIN orderdetail od ON p.productid = od.productid GROUP BY c.categoryid, c.categoryname ORDER BY total_quantity DESC

details.question: How many orders has each customer placed?
details.generated_sql: SELECT c.custid, c.companyname, COUNT(s.orderid) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN salesorder s ON c.custid = s.custid GROUP BY c.custid, c.companyname ORDER BY c.custid;

details.question: What is the average order value per customer?
details.generated_sql: SELECT so.custid, AVG(ot.order_total) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT od.orderid, SUM(od.unitprice * od.qty * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_total FROM orderdetail od GROUP BY od.orderid) ot JOIN salesorder so ON so.orderid = ot.orderid GROUP BY so.custid ORDER BY so.custid;

details.question: How many distinct products does each supplier provide?
details.generated_sql: SELECT s.supplierid, s.companyname, COUNT(DISTINCT p.productid) AS product_count FROM product p JOIN supplier s ON p.supplierid = s.supplierid GROUP BY s.supplierid, s.companyname;

details.question: What is the total freight cost associated with each shipper?
details.generated_sql:
SELECT s.shipperid, sh.companyname, SUM(s.freight) AS total_freight
FROM salesorder AS s
JOIN shipper AS sh ON s.shipperid = sh.shipperid
GROUP BY s.shipperid, sh.companyname;

details.question: How many orders were shipped by each shipping company?
details.generated_sql: SELECT shipper.companyname, COUNT(salesorder.orderid) AS order_count FROM shipper LEFT JOIN salesorder ON shipper.shipperid = salesorder.shipperid GROUP BY shipper.companyname ORDER BY order_count DESC;

details.question: List the products supplied by suppliers based in Japan.

details.question: Show the names of customers who have ordered products from the 'Seafood' category.
details.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.companyname FROM customer c JOIN salesorder so ON c.custid = so.custid JOIN orderdetail od ON so.orderid = od.orderid JOIN product p ON od.productid = p.productid JOIN category cat ON p.categoryid = cat.categoryid WHERE cat.categoryname = 'Seasea';

details.question: Which shipping companies have delivered orders for customers in Germany?

details.question: List all orders along with the name of the employee who handled each one.

details.question: Which suppliers provide products in the 'Condiments' category?

details.question: Show the order details for all orders placed by customers in Spain.
details.generated_sql: SELECT od.orderid, od.productid, od.unitprice, od.qty, od.discount FROM orderdetail od JOIN salesorder so ON od.orderid = so.orderid JOIN customer c ON so.custid = c.custid WHERE c.country = 'Spain';

details.question: List each employee along with the name of their manager.
details.generated_sql: SELECT e.empid, e.firstname, e.lastname, m.firstname AS manager_firstname, m.lastname AS manager_lastname FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee m ON e.mgrid = m.empid;

details.question: What is the month-over-month revenue trend for 2007, accounting for discounts?
details.generated_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', so.orderdate) AS month, SUM(od.unitprice * od.qty * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue FROM salesorder so JOIN orderdetail od ON so.orderid = od.orderid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.orderdate) = 2007 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

details.question: Which customers placed at least one order in every quarter of 2008?
details.generated_sql: SELECT c.custid, c.companyname, c.contactname, c.contacttitle, c.address, c.city, c.region, c.postalcode, c.country, c.phone, c.fax FROM customer c JOIN salesorder s ON c.custid = s.custid WHERE s.orderdate >= DATE '2008-01-01' AND s.orderdate < DATE '2009-01-01' GROUP BY c.custid, c.companyname, c.contactname, c.contacttitle, c.address, c.city, c.region, c.postalcode, c.country, c.phone, c.fax HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.orderdate)) = 4;

details.question: What is the average discount applied per product category?
details.generated_sql: SELECT c.categoryname, AVG(od.discount) AS avg_discount FROM orderdetail od JOIN product p ON od.productid = p.productid JOIN category c ON p.categoryid = c.categoryid GROUP BY c.categoryname;

details.question: Which products have generated more than $10,000 in total revenue, after accounting for discounts?
details.generated_sql: SELECT p.productid, p.productname, SUM(od.unitprice * od.qty * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM product p JOIN orderdetail od ON p.productid = od.productid GROUP BY p.productid, p.productname HAVING SUM(od.unitprice * od.qty * (1 - od.discount)) > 10000;

details.question: Rank employees by the total revenue generated from the orders they handled.
details.generated_sql:
SELECT e.empid, e.firstname, e.lastname,
       SUM(od.unitprice * od.qty * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(od.unitprice * od.qty * (1 - od.discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM employee e
JOIN salesorder so ON e.empid = so.empid
JOIN orderdetail od ON so.orderid = od.orderid
GROUP BY e.empid, e.firstname, e.lastname
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

details.question: What percentage of total line-item revenue came from order details with a discount greater than 0?
details.generated_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN total_rev = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * discounted_rev / total_rev END AS percentage_of_revenue FROM ( SELECT SUM(unitprice * qty * (1 - discount)) AS total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN discount > 0 THEN unitprice * qty * (1 - discount) ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_rev FROM orderdetail ) sub;

details.question: Give me a list of our best employees.

details.question: Show me the most successful product categories.
details.generated_sql:
SELECT c.categoryid, c.categoryname, SUM(od.qty * od.unitprice * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_sales
FROM category c
JOIN product p ON p.categoryid = c.categoryid
JOIN orderdetail od ON od.productid = p.productid
GROUP BY c.categoryid, c.categoryname
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
